newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No risk to Century in Pasminco buy - Canberra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No risk to Century in Pasminco buy - Canberra.

text.p: Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer said on Thursday that Pasminco Ltd's purchase of the Century zinc mine project would not affect the development's viability.

Asked whether the purchase would set back negotiations with Aboriginal tribes over the mine, Fischer said: "I am quietly confident that the announcement today will not have implications for mine viability or sovereign risk"

Earlier on Thursday, Pasminco said it would buy the Century project in northwest Queensland from RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd, with the deal subject to successful talks with Aboriginal groups who have claimed ownership of land in the region.
Pasminco would pay A$345 million for the zinc mine, which is potentially the world's largest.
